$comment: Manifest entries the XR module needs in every APK (runtime/xr README, 'Manifest'). tools/build-xr-apk.mjs inserts
them into runtime/app/template/AndroidManifest.xml for device builds; the template owner and the M5
packer should carry them. Sources: the Khronos OpenXR loader's own Android manifest (src/loader/AndroidManifest.xml.in,
OpenXR SDK 1.1.63: broker permissions and <queries> for Android 11+ package visibility) and Meta Horizon OS
manifest documentation (VR intent category, supported devices, focus awareness, head tracking, hand tracking,
passthrough). Features the app does not use can be dropped by the packer from the iwsdk.config.json native section.
